<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (two peaks), and 128.30 (two peaks) fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110‑160 ppm). That accounts for 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons. No other peaks are in that region.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
